about: The campaign (docs/GAME-V3.md section 4): what opens on an island after each won wave. One table for the server and the browser: the server reads this file (catalogue.py), the browser a copy in frontend/src/campaign/campaign.json, and a test keeps the two equal. The island's best won wave decides what is open on it. Ids: <kind>:<level> for a building level, crew:<crew>, captain:<level>, a spot group of 'spots' (ring_walls), and the island's services (harbor, market_calls, football_board, wreck, tech_hub). A step with later: true is shown as coming later and is not built yet.

steps.title: Walls and cannons
steps.line: Build walls and cannons on the glowing spots. Your captain carries a musket.

steps.title: New: Captain upgrades and houses!
steps.line: Open Menu › Captain and skills to make your musket stronger. Houses add loot after every won wave.

steps.title: New: Level 2 and the mortar!
steps.line: Tap a cannon or a wall to raise it to level 2. A mortar hits every ship near the impact.

steps.title: New: Watchtower and gunner!
steps.line: The watchtower gives every tower more range. Hire a gunner in Menu › Crew.

steps.title: New: The Harbor is open!
steps.line: Walk to the Harbor on the beach. Its market stall takes calls: up or down in 5 minutes?

steps.title: New: The inner wall ring and level 3!
steps.line: Raise the six walls around the heart. Hire a carpenter to mend walls during a wave.

steps.title: A wreck washed ashore!
steps.line: Everyone can pay coins into her repair, a little after every wave.

steps.title: New: The match board at the Harbor!
steps.line: Pick who wins a real football match at the Harbor.

steps.title: New: The Tech hub!
steps.line: Research a tower kind once, and every tower of that kind on the island can pick a skill.

steps.title: The repaired ship
steps.line: Sailing out to fight at sea comes later.

steps.title: Raiders join the fleet!
steps.line: Fast red-sailed raiders sail in from now on.

steps.title: Bigger warships!
steps.line: The boss warships are tougher from now on.

steps.title: Brutes come ashore!
steps.line: Big brutes hack walls faster and take more hits.

steps.title: Ironclads!
steps.line: Iron-plated brigs join the fleet. Research and skills matter now.

steps.title: Dreadnoughts!
steps.line: Redtide sends his dreadnoughts. It takes the whole crew now.
